title: Harden the physical-engineering proposal into a fail-closed advisory screening gate
intent: Add PhysicalEngineeringProposalV1 as an untrusted claim, then require a validator-owned evidence resolver and an explicit test policy before any verdict. Geometry stays an untrusted claim. The gate is not mounted on a route and does not authorize physical work.
behavior_change: New library only. validate_proposal now requires a resolver and a ValidationPolicyV1, resolves evidence itself, computes projected remaining thickness, and freezes a replayable snapshot. No route, mesh, calculator, or manufacturing output calls it.

diff_articulation.what_changed: services/api/app/physical_engineering is a new package. EvidenceRef carries only ref_id and expected_kind. InMemoryEvidenceResolver recomputes SHA-256 over opaque bytes. ValidationPolicyV1 supplies max_test_removal_mm and min_test_remaining_thickness_mm with no production default. validate_proposal rejects a missing resolver or policy with ValidatorConfigurationError before any verdict. Kind mismatch is REJECTED / EVIDENCE_KIND_MISMATCH. A missing reference is EVIDENCE_REQUIRED / EVIDENCE_REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND. A digest mismatch is REJECTED / EVIDENCE_DIGEST_MISMATCH. Projected remaining thickness below the test minimum is EVIDENCE_REQUIRED / THICKNESS_CONFLICT_WITH_REMOVAL; equality passes. MODIFY_BRACE is REJECTED / ACTION_NOT_YET_GOVERNED. The verdict field is advisory_review_allowed. capture_snapshot freezes the proposal, resolved evidence, policy, validator version, contradiction-rule version, and verdict under snapshot_sha256. replay_validation takes no resolver. screening.py holds the rule functions so proposal_v1.py stays under the 500-line ratchet. GeometryRegion is still an agent claim.
diff_articulation.why: An agent proposal must not carry measured values, a resolves flag, or an authority grant, and a caller-supplied evidence bundle must not be treated as independent confirmation. The hardened gate separates untrusted citations from validator-owned bytes and keeps the historical verdict stable when the live store changes.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: No physical-engineering proposal type existed on main. The first commit imports the corrected baseline and its 66 tests. The second commit deletes that caller-supplied evidence bundle, AdvisoryReviewContext, advisory_authority_granted, and MAX_SINGLE_PASS_REMOVAL_MM, and replaces them with the resolver, the test policy, the projected-thickness rule, and snapshot replay. Mesh integration is deferred to PEP-MESH-SEAM-003. Wire canonicalization is deferred to PEP-V1-CONTRACT-002.
diff_articulation.what_did_not_change: services/api/app/mesh was not modified. No router, calculator, CAM export, or manufacturing inventory calls this gate. 0.6 is not a module constant; it appears only as a test-policy fixture. The gate does not claim physical admissibility.

commands_run: git rev-parse origin/main  # d989d54240bfddd6fd21eff7389633e0903f4405; gh pr list --state open returned []
proofs: 84 tests passed, including the original refusal cases updated to the new contract and the resolver, digest, kind, projected-thickness, configuration, and replay cases.
Replay after deleting a live fixture artifact still returns the frozen ADVISORY_ALLOWED verdict, and a fresh validate_proposal call on the mutated store returns EVIDENCE_REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND.
No file under services/api/app/mesh is in the diff.
verification.hardware: No machine execution and no manufacturing output. Policy numbers are test thresholds only.
